comment.en: Fog is the main driver of Hualien's disruption risk over the next 5 days, with 14 of 20 periods rated Medium for fog. The US model shows low visibility in these periods, for example only 48 m on 11/2 20:00 to 11/3 02:00 and 54 m on 10/30 14:00–20:00. Only the US model takes part in the fog vote, so it is rated Medium; the model-based fog rating tops out at Medium. Gusts in all models stay at or below 17 kt, the chance of gusts over 49 kt is 0% throughout, and there is no airport forecast, airport observation or official warning.
